summary: An ambient firmware that starts playing at power-on, with lo-fi, nature and slow generative drift scenes, and a looper that picks up and layers what you play on the keys.
features: 16 scenes in three modes: LOFI, SCAPES and DRIFT
Six spaces: hall, plate, cloud, shimmer, tape and reverse
LISTEN mode loops your phrases; HOLD plants self-playing notes
Up to eight loop layers; library of the last eight loops
Chord pages, drum and bass step editors; scenes evolve over time
USB MIDI notes on channel 1; USB audio for recording
